name: Greek worry beads (komboloi)
about: Komboloi are strings of beads that Greeks handle to pass the time and calm their hands. They are an everyday part of Greek culture found in cafes and homes across Athens.
tip: Check the material: resin, amber, and stone beads feel and sound different, so handle a few before you choose.

name: Olive oil and soap
unit: 500 ml of oil or 1 bar of soap
about: Greece is one of the world's largest olive oil producers, and Athens markets sell local oil and traditional olive oil soap. Buying them here lets you take home a true taste of Greek everyday life.
tip: Look for "extra virgin" on the label and check the acidity level, which should be low, as a sign of quality.
